chapters.title: Chapter 78 - "Show me what trick you had planned."
paragraphs: Hei Yeming froze as he heard his brother’s screams lose more and more strength before finally ceasing altogether.
"Come on..." Qingyi’s cold voice entered his ears, causing him to shiver.

"Show me what trick you had planned. You didn’t go into this fight thinking you’d win with just this pathetic strength, did you?" Qingyi waved his hands lightly, wiping away the blood that covered them before picking up his sword from the ground.
Looking at the destruction in front of him, he couldn’t help but shake his head.
The path of cultivation was truly cruel.
A few months ago, Qingyi was just a young man serving his master, coming from a much gentler world and never having seen human blood.
But now, his kill count was well into the hundreds and yet he felt nothing. Not even a single tremor in his heart.
The only thing that unsettled him was the sight of his Elize wounded - all those corpses were irrelevant in the face of a single strand of her hair.
Yeming struggled against his body, trying to get up.
Tears streamed down his face as his lips parted, a soft grunt soon turning into uncontrolled laughter.
"Ah..." His voice filled with anger as he roared. "Do you want to see our latest fucking trick? Very well!"
He shoved his hands into his robes, pulling out a pill similar to the one his brother had tried to use before being killed by Qingyi.
It was deep red, covered in black spots. Without hesitation, he threw it into his mouth and swallowed it.
His body began to change immediately. His eyelids turned red and, from his flaming aura, threads of dark, disgusting Qi emerged.
"Is that... Demonic Qi?" Qingyi’s eyes widened.
It was exactly the same Qi he had sensed from Tianming, only slightly weaker.
Observing that power, Qingyi immediately understood their plan.
They wanted to test him first, see the limit of his power and, if necessary, use those pills.
Unfortunately for them, Qingyi’s power was even greater than they expected, and Hei Langya didn’t even have time to take his pill before he was killed.
’It would be really problematic if both of them had gone full force from the start...’ Qingyi thought.
Those were cultivation enhancement pills, already naturally rare and extremely dangerous, while demonic enhancement pills were even more vicious.
Not that he expected bandits to measure risks with these things.
Erasing useless thoughts from his mind, he focused his eyes on Yeming again.
His body had swollen grotesquely past two meters, his eyes wide as he roared: "I WILL KILL YOU!"
His massive figure exploded at speed towards Qingyi, raising his sword over his head before dropping it on the young man.
A metallic clang echoed as his sword met Qingyi’s, whose legs sank into the ground as Yeming pushed even harder.
"Powerful..." Qingyi muttered, feeling his arms tremble. "But not powerful enough!"
In the next moment, his lightning sword Qi exploded, its blade slowly sinking into Yeming’s blade, whose metal soon began to turn red.
With a final surge of power, Qingyi’s sword completely cut through Yeming’s weapon, sinking into his shoulder.
"Ugh... fuck!" Yeming tried to back away, the ground beneath his feet cracking as he jumped.
"You’re not going anywhere!" Qingyi appeared right below him, his blade tearing through Yeming’s legs.
Even with his body strengthened with demonic Qi, it still wasn’t enough to stop Qingyi’s blade.
The pill had greatly increased Yeming’s power, to a level where he probably wouldn’t lose to any cultivator below the eighth stage of the foundation realm.
But unfortunately for him, with his new combat technique, spiritual roots and bloodline level, Qingyi could easily compete and even win against cultivators at the peak of the foundation realm.
"Do you know why you’re going to die suffering?" Qingyi asked, as Yeming’s crippled body fell heavily.
He tried to struggle, but not even all the Qi he could extract from that pill was enough.
"It’s for the same reason that your brother died in agony." Qingyi stepped on Yeming’s head.
Slowly, he increased the force of his stomp, ignoring Yeming’s desperate attempts to free himself by punching and grabbing Qingyi’s foot.
With one last thrust, Qingyi’s feet sank completely into Yeming’s head, his last pained cry being silenced as his skull was crushed.
"Ah..." Qingyi sighed, looking at the destruction around him.
The Red Claw gang wasn’t entirely finished yet and he had to fight hard against the urge to just run into their headquarters and kill everything in front of him.
But he held back, he didn’t even know where they were located, and taking care of Elize was his priority.
Hastening his steps, he returned to the temple courtyard, his eyes falling on Elize who, still drenched in blood, was cultivating peacefully.
Her aura had stabilized and her beautiful purple eyes opened, meeting Qingyi’s.
She stood up, using all the strength she still had in her body to throw herself into Qingyi’s arms.
She didn’t say anything, nor did she have the strength to do so, just sinking her face into his chest.
"I’m sorry, love..." Qingyi shuddered before returning her hug, stroking her hair.
Raising his face, his eyes met those of Yueli.
The blue-haired beauty was slightly flushed, but after a moment’s hesitation, she finally approached.
Qingyi carefully grabbed her wrists before also pulling her into his embrace, the two beauties snuggling in his arms.
"I think we have a lot to talk about..." Qingyi whispered.
"Yes..." Yueli turned her face slightly, watching Elize.
"Can we do this in the hot springs? I’m filthy..." Elize smiled tiredly, drawing a laugh from Yueli and Qingyi.
"What are you laughing at? You’re filthy too!" Yueli puffed out her cheeks before being shushed by Qingyi’s lips.
"Should we clean up this mess first?" Qingyi asked, looking at the pile of corpses around them.
"Hm... the girls do that, they don’t have weak stomachs." Yueli turned away from Qingyi, finally going into the throne room and releasing the anxious and worried priestesses.
"’Big sister Yueli, what happened?"
"Where’s big sister Elize?"
"Big sister Elize, is everything all right?"
The girls left the temple, their eyes shuddering at the scene of destruction around them.

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - Big sister Yueli is so naughty!
paragraphs: "You sure you don’t want to get some sleep first?" Qingyi asked as he carried Elize on his arms along the trail, holding her like a princess.
She had already taken a quick bath in the temple while Qingyi swept the entire area for miles around, cleaning off all the blood that covered her.
After making sure everything was safe, they made up some excuse to leave the girls to clean up the mess in the temple while they went up to the hot springs.

"No, I’m fine..." Elize said, although the damage to her body had been terrible, the damage to her meridians hadn’t been too great, with the high-quality recovery pill Qingyi had given her healing almost all of her injuries.
Still, all the mental fatigue of a bloody battle and a forced advance remained.
Her Qi reserves were almost completely empty and her cultivation base was very unstable.
Despite all this, she still clung to Qingyi’s robes, refusing to let go of him for a single moment.
"Ah..." He sighed heavily, shook his head, and turned his face towards Yueli.
She was walking awkwardly.
On the one hand, a great weight had been lifted from her heart by seeing Qingyi’s power and finally feeling that her sisters were safe and free from the Red Claw gang.
If Qingyi had the power to defeat those two, she didn’t doubt at all that he would be able to defeat their leader.
But on the other hand, she couldn’t help feeling uncomfortable about the whole thing...

Qingyi appeared out of nowhere, pulled out a pill so powerful that she herself believed it to be miraculous when she saw the effects on Elize, and now that she thought about it, she didn’t see any money or pills on his clothes as he helped the girls treat his injuries.
He didn’t have any storage items either.
Where had the pill he used on Elize and the money he used to buy that wine come from?
"Is everything all right?" Qingyi asked, worried.
"Yes..." Yueli lowered her head, her fingers curling into a loose braid of hair. "It’s just... it all happened too quickly and..." she killed her own words, her lips closing tightly.
Should she ask about Qingyi’s origins? About those items? What if he had secrets that it was better not to know about? It all made her even more anxious.
"We’re here..." Qingyi whispered, her attention being diverted when the warm, flowery breeze from the temple’s hot springs reached her face.
She loved this place, but the thought of bathing with Qingyi made her heart soar.
To her surprise, Elize immediately jumped out of Qingyi’s arms, her clothes sliding down her voluptuous curves as she stepped into the water.
"The water’s so nice... what are you waiting for?" She dived in up to her neck, her voice still a little slurred as she relaxed her body.
"Stop worrying too much." Qingyi smiled at Yueli, stroking her hair before removing his own clothes, revealing his powerful body and the impressive member between his legs.
He stepped into the water, pulled Elize onto his lap and sealed their lips in a brief but sweet kiss.
Yueli flushed at the sight, a rosy blush taking over her cheeks as she hesitated.
She finally grabbed her robes, pulling them down, first revealing beautiful, pale shoulders, and then large, firm breasts before the robes finally fell over her curvaceous hips.
Her steps were trembling, her small, delicate feet touching the water gently before sinking up to her thighs.
Qingyi’s strong hands immediately grabbed her waist and pulled her onto his lap next to Elize.

It was a bit of a squeeze, clearly with little room for both of them, but even so, Qingyi clung to them, feeling their breasts pressed against his chest like soft, warm pillows as their juicy asses took over his lap.
’Ah... if only Feiyan were here too...’ He thought, his eyes closing briefly.
He’d find a way to get a place for her, even if it meant growing a third leg...
Well, technically he already had a third leg and the tanned beauty would probably love to use it as a seat.
’Ah... one thing at a time...’ He shook his head.
He really hoped that Feiyan was all right. After finishing things here, he would run straight to her.
He actually wanted to go right now. To grab Yueli and Elize, take them to the sect and introduce them to their "big sister. "
But he couldn’t do that.
The temple was too weakened, they would never leave their sisters behind, he knew that, and he himself would never force them to do something like that.
’Meybe if their master were still alive...’ he thought.
That would solve a lot of things.

Of course, he could also simply take all those women, fuck them, brand them and take them with him, but feeling Elize and Yueli’s soft, warm breaths against him, he couldn’t help but hesitate at the idea.

He gritted his teeth, his face filling with hatred as he gripped the mighty axe displayed above his throne.

The entire fortress of the Red Claw Gang shook with a thunderous explosion.

The pill had fallen to the ground, covered in blood.
’Where are my hands?’ His eyes widened.

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - Red claw gang (02)
paragraphs: "FUCK... MOTHERFUCKER!" Hei Hunli screamed as his wrists bled non-stop, his two hands falling to the ground in front of him, painting it red.
Qingyi ignored him, picking up that strange pill.
It was exactly the same as the one used by the other two Hei brothers, in fact, it seemed to be a little more powerful.
He was curious what Hei Hunli’s power would be after taking that pill, but after seeing his base power, he realized that it was better not to risk it.

Hei Yeming had raised his power by three stages with a pill of inferior quality. If he allowed Hei Hunli to take that pill too, his power could easily exceed a level that would be dangerous for Qingyi.
"Where does that come from?" Qingyi asked coldly before swinging his leg, delivering a powerful kick to Hunli’s face and knocking out some of his teeth.
"Ugh... Fuck you!" Hunli cursed, his eyes watering and any hint of greed wiped from his face.
All that remained was hatred, sorrow and fear. Hatred above all.
"Ah..." Qingyi sighed. "Do you think the pain you’re feeling is a lot?" He asked, his cold voice full of amusement.
He plunged his sword into Hei Hunli’s left foot, and, without even giving him time to react, spread his lightning Qi across the blade, from where it flowed into the bandit’s feet.
The amount of Qi was relatively small, but it was enough to cause shrill cries of agony to spread throughout the forest.
Many of the bandits who were fleeing stopped briefly when they heard those screams, looking back and recognizing the voice of their leader.
Their faces were filled with relief that they had fled instead of trusting their leader.
"Tell me, where does this pill come from?" Qingyi asked again, removing his sword from Hei Hunli’s foot and placing the pill in front of his bloodied, tear-covered face.
Still, he resisted, his lips twisting into a bloody smile.
He knew full well that he would die and preferred to leave with a proud smile on his face.
"You fuck the women who should belong to me, you kill my brothers and you still want answers from me?" Hunli spat, unable to reach Qingyi’s face, but still hard enough to stain the pure white robes.
Qingyi frowned, moving his sword to Hunli’s right foot.
The bandit’s bloody smile soon distorted into cries of pain and despair as the lightning Qi destroyed his flesh, muscles and even his meridians.
"You’re going to die, but it can happen much more quickly. Just tell me, where the hell did you get that pill from? What’s your connection to the demon cult?"
Qingyi’s questioning was again answered by nothing but crazed laughter and cursing.
His sword soon moved to Hunli’s heels, then to his knees, his thighs and even his groin.
But despite all the torture, not a single word left his lips, and his body, torn apart by lightning qi, soon lost its life.
"Crap..." Qingyi kicked Hunli’s corpse as he stood up.
Although it wasn’t really his problem, he would have preferred to know where those pills came from, especially to prevent anyone who could hurt his women from ending up with them.
He also didn’t know Hunli’s central reason for wanting his women. Was it really for his harem? Or perhaps to sacrifice them to the demon cult?
The thought sent shivers down his spine. The demon cult was well known for burning the souls of its victims in their sacrifices.
Extremely talented virgins were a feast for them.
He was about to leave when he suddenly felt a presence inside the fortress, in the confines of the palace that Hunli inhabited.
It was a faint presence, which had been completely erased by the aura of Hunli and the other bandits.
But now he could feel it clearly.
With quick steps, he entered the luxurious throne room, his eyes focusing on a small door hidden behind the throne.
"Locked..." He muttered, taking a single step back before kicking the door open with a bang.
In front of him was just one corridor, so long that it seemed endless, with a step descending every few meters.
Qingyi kept his sword in his grip as he walked down the corridor.
It was strange. The walls and floor were made of a refined, high-quality wood, superior even to that of which Heilin’s throne room was made.
But there were no doors or windows, as if the entire corridor had only been made as a path to a single place.
"What a waste..." He muttered and soon his steps stopped. He had reached the end of the corridor.
There was only one door, plain and unremarkable in appearance, and it wasn’t even locked. But Qingyi could sense that there was someone on the other side.
When he finally opened the door, he heard a hoarse, muffled cry.
A man with long gray hair wearing old robes was hiding in a corner of the room.
"P-please don’t kill me, I’m just a humble slave!" The old man prostrated himself, banging his head hard against the floor.
But Qingyi didn’t let his guard down.
This was a man already at the end of his life, but feeling his suppressed aura, he immediately realized that this man was a cultivator of the Foundation Realm, one whose cultivation was not sealed.
It was obvious that he was not a slave.
The handsome young man’s eyes swept the room.
It was a simple place, with a few supplies and a desk covered in scrolls, reports and letters.
"You’re hiding something from me..." Qingyi muttered, his cold, penetrating voice causing the old man to shiver. "Show me or I’ll rip it out of your corpse."
It wasn’t difficult to get the old man to give in. His wrinkled, trembling hands removed a small bag from his robes.
"P-please, I have nothing to do with those bandits, I just-"
"Silence." Qingyi interrupted the old man, grabbing the small bag and opening it.
Inside were fifteen pills, identical to those used by the Hei brothers.

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - I won’t kill you
paragraphs: "Ah..." Qingyi sighed heavily as he got up from the old man’s bloodied body.
Fortunately, the old man was a coward, so it wasn’t difficult to find out what he needed to know.

Those pills had been bought directly from the main land, imported to the island by pirates and flowed through the hands of many wandering merchants until finally falling into the hands of the Red Claw gang.
There didn’t seem to be any connection between the Red Claw gang and the demon cult, which immediately made him feel relieved.
Of course, the circulation of these pills was still a big problem, but as long as it didn’t affect his women, it wasn’t his problem.
Still, he decided it was best to take them back to the sect and report everything he had discovered to the old man, at least what was relevant.
After all, many elders were known for giving generous rewards to disciples who made great discoveries and information about the demon sect was always important.
Putting the pills back in the bag, Qingyi prepared to store them in his clothes, but soon remembered something.
Although he’d had the system for many months and his power had risen a lot, he still hadn’t bought himself a space ring.
Going around carrying a lot of things was very inconvenient.
"P-please..."
Qingyi was about to open his system store when the old man called out to him again.
’Is that bastard still alive?’ He drew his sword without hesitation. He had no pity for that old man, he was a criminal like any other in this fortress.
If he had been an innocent servant or slave, his cultivation would surely have been sealed or crippled.
From what he could see in the room, this old man was an accountant and the main person responsible for running the fortress.
He thought the old man was already dead after torturing him a bit, but as they say, bad things are hard to die. Qingyi raised his sword over his head, causing the old man to let out a shrill scream.
"W-wait! Wait! I can show you the fortress vault, all the gang’s wealth is in there!" The old man raised his trembling hands and closed his eyes in terror.
"Uh?" Qingyi stopped the swing of his sword.
The Red Claw gang wasn’t exactly a new gang. With over a thousand members, it was founded by the Hei brothers’ father some 150 years ago, an expert of the Golden Core realm.
With all that time stealing and killing, they probably had a considerable fortune.
Even if Qingyi could buy gold directly from the system, the price wasn’t something he liked.
This wouldn’t be a big problem if all he wanted was to buy simple things like low-quality pills, drinks and meals, but to buy more expensive items, it would become totally unaffordable.
Lust points were great for boosting cultivation, but they were far from being able to replace gold.
"Speak," Qingyi ordered, even buying a recovery pill and throwing it to the old man, who immediately chomped it down as if his whole life depended on it.
Observing such a sight, Qingyi couldn’t help but shake his head.
A Foundation Realm cultivator could easily live over a hundred and thirty years. From the looks of this old man, he was already past the one hundred and twenty mark.
It was truly pathetic to see someone so old, who had already lived so long, clinging to life like this.
"I-I’ll talk, but first, I want you to promise-" The old man’s voice died away as Qingyi took a threatening step forward, but he hastened his voice.
"If you promise before the heavens that you won’t kill me, I’ll show you the vault!" He lowered his head and Qingyi stopped the movement of his blade once again.
Promises before the heavens were very serious things for most cultivators.
Breaking them didn’t affect them directly, but many said that they caused karma and could hinder their future reincarnations as well as generating tribulations if the promise was too big.
Qingyi didn’t care much about such things, he had no interest in living any life other than this one, nor was he a very religious person.
[You should still be careful with this, these promises don’t have much influence in the mortal heavens, but the higher you go, the more powerful the power of destiny linked to the heavens]
The system warned.
’Don’t worry.’ Qingyi smiled slightly, he wasn’t planning on breaking that promise.
"I promise, before the heavens and all the deities that govern it, that I, Qingyi, will not lay a finger on you." He exclaimed and soon the old man’s face filled with excitement.
"Ugh... those old bones." The old man stood up with a grunt, walking in large strides towards the wall of the room.
Qingyi watched with curiosity as the old man tapped on the wall seemingly at random.
After about ten taps, a loud crack was heard and the wooden walls soon broke apart, revealing a black metal door.
"Here you are, young master! Now... if you’ll excuse me..." The old man took hasty steps away, but Qingyi grabbed his shoulders.
"Open it," he ordered coldly.
Swallowing dryly, the old man stepped back in front of the metal door, grabbed its handle and, with a little effort, opened it.
Qingyi’s face immediately lit up with a golden color as the contents of the safe were finally revealed.
It was relatively empty compared to its size, but from the pile of jewels, gold and even some pills, he could estimate a value of easily over a hundred thousand gold coins.
It wasn’t a large amount for high-level cultivators, but for a foundation realm cultivator like him? It was a real fortune!
’System, I need a spatial ring, at least twenty cubic meters,’ Qingyi ordered. Five thousand lust points disappeared from his status as a silver ring appeared on his finger.
He closed his eyes briefly, feeling a connection with the ring forming.
It was a little strange, not like a game inventory, but like a cluster of information being sent directly to his head.
Qingyi raised his index finger slightly and a powerful suction force arose, pulling all the wealth in the vault into his ring.
There, he only needed one thought to calculate exactly how much it was.
"One hundred and fifty thousand..." A subtle smile took over his face.
With that much gold, there would be no shortage of resources, either for him or for his women.
"Can I go now?" The old man asked, almost begging, but Qingyi just laughed.
"Get into the vault..." He ordered.
"You promised you wouldn’t kill me..." Despite his protests, the old man obeyed, afraid of being killed right then and there.
"Don’t worry, I won’t kill you."
The old man’s face was filled with relief at those words, but that relief soon disappeared as Qingyi closed the vault door.
"Hunger, thirst and lack of oxygen will," Qingyi muttered as he used his lightning Qi to melt the metal of the door, welding it to the rest of the vault.

chapters.title: Chapter 84 - Blue Wing mercenaries
paragraphs: Right after finishing everything he had to do in the Red Claw gang’s stronghold, Qingyi immediately set off towards the capital of the Heavenly Thunder Kingdom.
He was happy, with a ton of lust points, a ton of gold and, soon, a powerful sword. How could he complain about life?
He thought about stopping by the temple to let the girls know that everything was fine, but after some thought, he decided to head straight to the capital.
Going to the temple would delay him for at least another day, and he wanted to reach his destination fast.
With quick steps, he crossed the rainy, thunderous night sky.
Even using his lightning steps, it still took him almost four days to finally reach the kingdom’s capital.
Stopping on a small hill, he observed the city.

It was large, protected by mighty walls that seemed to have been forged from steel, rising more than twenty meters high and encompassing an urban area capable of easily housing more than a million people.

It was obviously incomparable to the great capitals of the mainland, but it was nonetheless impressive, situated in a deep, well-protected valley. At its back, a mountain was visible, similar to the mountain of the Ascending Dragon Sect.
However, instead of being green and covered in golden clouds, this one was black, with dark storm clouds forming a carpet that completely covered its peak.
This was the mountain where the Spirit of Lightning had sealed itself.
Qingyi didn’t know much about it, and the few records he found in the temple library were confusing.
His eyes soon focused on the gates of the capital and the almost endless queue of people trying to enter the city.
"This looks even more tumultuous than Golden Cloud City..." he muttered, before taking a look at himself.
He was filthy, at least by the standards of a cultivator of his level. His clothes were still stained with dried blood and his body was covered in sweat.
Shaking his head, he extended his senses to make sure no one was around before wiping away the sweat and changing quickly.
It wasn’t perfect, but it was enough.
With light steps, he soon joined the slowly advancing queue.
"You seem to be new here! You’re here to go to the Tempest Secret realm, aren’t you?" A voice called out to him.
Turning around, he found a young man with short hair and big eyes, perhaps in his seventeenth year, his cultivation no higher than the third stage of the Qi Refining Realm.
Without even giving Qingyi time to reply, the young man continued, puffing out his chest: "If you need a guide, the Blue Wing mercenaries are always free. We’ll do it for a cheap price, hehehe."
"Liu Xiaogou, you damned brat, what did I tell you about disturbing strangers in the street?" A tall, powerful man emerged from behind him, his fist coming down on Xiaogou’s head with a thud.
"Ugh..." The young man groaned painfully before defending himself. "I wasn’t disturbing him, Brother Laosan, I was making him an offer!"
Unfortunately, those words weren’t enough. Laosan grabbed the young man’s head and forced him to prostrate himself.
"I beg your pardon for my little brother, senior. He has a big mouth, but no brain!" Laosan hastily apologized.
He was at the ninth stage of the Refining Realm, having reached that level at the age of 45.
He was relatively talented in the Heavenly Thunder Realm, he even had a chance of reaching the Foundation Realm if he was lucky.
But even so, he could barely feel Qingyi’s aura, as if the handsome young man didn’t even exist, and this immediately made his heart freeze.
Qingyi was probably a Foundation Realm expert and, by his apparent age, a young man of unparalleled talent!
"Don’t worry," Qingyi smiled slightly, Laosan’s face filled with relief.
Fortunately that senior seemed to have a good heart.
"But he’s right, I’m new here and I need a guide. How much will it cost?
"Well-" Laosan opened his mouth, but Xiaogou immediately cut him off.
"Fifty gold coins and we’ll accompany you wherever you want in the Tempest Secret realm!"
"You damned brat!" Laosan lost control, grabbing Xiaogou.
’Why the hell can’t this brat go a single second without trying to kill himself?’ he thought. Fifty gold coins was simply absurd for the services they offered.
His eyes were about to tear up when he heard Qingyi’s next words.
"All right, I’ll pay." Qingyi smiled, opening his space ring. The next moment, a small pouch with exactly fifty gold coins appeared in his hands.
Laosan looked at the money with shock.
Had that expert really withdrawn that much money without even caring?
His group barely made that much in a month, not to mention a single service! He couldn’t stop his eyes from glazing over as he accepted the payment.

"Thank you very much, senior, I promise to guide you well!" Laosan clenched his fists before leading Qingyi to the front of the queue, where his group was waiting for them in a simple wagon with three other people.
Xiaogou jumped into the wagon proudly before pointing: "The ugly guy driving is Li Gouzi. He makes very good fried chicken!"
Then he pointed to the only woman in the group, an ordinary-looking woman with full breasts, her dry lips tinged with a gentle smile.

"She’s big sister Mei. She’s very good with water qi. And that’s Chen Tiezhu over there. He likes big axes!" He indicated the last one, a tall man with very little hair, who nodded amicably to Qingyi.
"Who the hell did you call ugly? You filthy brat!" Li Gouzi almost let go of the reins of the bull driving the carriage, but Laosan’s voice quickly silenced him.
"Have some manners in front of our honorable client!" Laosan scolded him before apologizing to Qingyi. "I’m sorry for the rudeness of my companions, senior!"
"It’s okay..." Qingyi couldn’t stop a muffled laugh from escaping his lips. That seemed to be quite an interesting group of people.

He was filthy, at least by the standards of a cultivator of his level.
His clothes were still stained with dried blood and his body was covered in sweat.
Shaking his head, he extended his senses to make sure no one was around before wiping away the sweat and changing quickly.
It wasn’t perfect, but it was enough.
With light steps, he soon joined the slowly advancing queue.
"You seem to be new here!
You’re here to go to the Tempest Secret realm, aren’t you?" A voice called out to him.
Turning around, he found a young man with short hair and big eyes, perhaps in his seventeenth year, his cultivation no higher than the third stage of the Qi Refining Realm.
Without even giving Qingyi time to reply, the young man continued, puffing out his chest: "If you need a guide, the Blue Wing mercenaries are always free.
We’ll do it for a cheap price, hehehe."
"Liu Xiaogou, you damned brat, what did I tell you about disturbing strangers in the street?" A tall, powerful man emerged from behind him, his fist coming down on Xiaogou’s head with a thud.
"Ugh..." The young man groaned painfully before defending himself.
"I wasn’t disturbing him, Brother Laosan, I was making him an offer!"
Unfortunately, those words weren’t enough.
Laosan grabbed the young man’s head and forced him to prostrate himself.
"I beg your pardon for my little brother, senior.
He has a big mouth, but no brain!" Laosan hastily apologized.
He was at the ninth stage of the Refining Realm, having reached that level at the age of 45.
He was relatively talented in the Heavenly Thunder Realm, he even had a chance of reaching the Foundation Realm if he was lucky.
But even so, he could barely feel Qingyi’s aura, as if the handsome young man didn’t even exist, and this immediately made his heart freeze.
Qingyi was probably a Foundation Realm expert and, by his apparent age, a young man of unparalleled talent!
"Don’t worry," Qingyi smiled slightly, Laosan’s face filled with relief.
Fortunately that senior seemed to have a good heart.
"But he’s right, I’m new here and I need a guide.
How much will it cost?
"Well-" Laosan opened his mouth, but Xiaogou immediately cut him off.
"Fifty gold coins and we’ll accompany you wherever you want in the Tempest Secret realm!"
"You damned brat!" Laosan lost control, grabbing Xiaogou.
’Why the hell can’t this brat go a single second without trying to kill himself?’ he thought.
Fifty gold coins was simply absurd for the services they offered.
His eyes were about to tear up when he heard Qingyi’s next words.
"All right, I’ll pay." Qingyi smiled, opening his space ring.
The next moment, a small pouch with exactly fifty gold coins appeared in his hands.
Laosan looked at the money with shock.
Had that expert really withdrawn that much money without even caring?
His group barely made that much in a month, not to mention a single service!
He couldn’t stop his eyes from glazing over as he accepted the payment.

"Thank you very much, senior, I promise to guide you well!" Laosan clenched his fists before leading Qingyi to the front of the queue, where his group was waiting for them in a simple wagon with three other people.
Xiaogou jumped into the wagon proudly before pointing: "The ugly guy driving is Li Gouzi.
He makes very good fried chicken!"
Then he pointed to the only woman in the group, an ordinary-looking woman with full breasts, her dry lips tinged with a gentle smile.
"She’s big sister Mei.
She’s very good with water qi.
And that’s Chen Tiezhu over there.
He likes big axes!" He indicated the last one, a tall man with very little hair, who nodded amicably to Qingyi.
"Who the hell did you call ugly?
You filthy brat!" Li Gouzi almost let go of the reins of the bull driving the carriage, but Laosan’s voice quickly silenced him.
"Have some manners in front of our honorable client!" Laosan scolded him before apologizing to Qingyi.
"I’m sorry for the rudeness of my companions, senior!"
"It’s okay..." Qingyi couldn’t stop a muffled laugh from escaping his lips.
That seemed to be quite an interesting group of people.

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - Serene Cloud Sect
paragraphs: Qingyi quickly settled into the group’s wagon.
They were very close to the gate, but given the speed at which the queue was flowing, it should be at least another hour before they finally manage to enter the city.
During this time, Qingyi took the opportunity to find out more about the lightning spirit sealing site.
He was quite surprised at how wrong all the books in the temple were.
That mountain wasn’t simply a sealing site; it was actually an entire secret realm called the Tempest Secret Realm, full of rare spirit materials and powerful spirit beasts.
This secret realm opened once a year, where tens of thousands of cultivators tried their luck.
Even if they weren’t lightning cultivators, they could still end up rich if they obtained some rare lightning essence or killed a spirit beast.
The lightning spirit itself was well known, standing on the highest part of the mountain, but few actually tried to challenge it.
Firstly, because most of them never got there, and for all those who did, death was certain.
In the end, only a few crazy adventurers really tried their luck at conquering the lightning spirit. None ever came back alive.
The Blue Wing mercenary group could already be considered veterans in that secret realm, having faced it for ten years in a row without losing a single member.
Even so, they never even came close to the spirit of lightning.
While thinking about the Tempest Secret Realm, Qingyi paused for a brief moment.
His eyes filtered to a caravan arriving in the distance.
They didn’t even bother with the queue, cutting their way through.
Any complaints from those who were overtaken were directly erased by a deep, crushing aura.
’An Iron Body Realm cultivator... what is someone so powerful doing here?’ Qingyi wondered.
There shouldn’t be anyone of that cultivation on this island.
His eyes swept over the caravan, then focused on the banners they carried.
"Serene Cloud Sect," he muttered.
He knew that sect well, it was one of the most powerful in the entire outer region of the Blue Moon Continent, part of the three great sects.

The Ascending Dragon Sect, the most powerful, ruled the east; the Burning Heart Sect ruled the south; and the Serene Cloud Sect ruled the west, while the north was an inhospitable and cold region, often considered part of the Nine Peaks Basin.

This was the general distribution of power in that region. This ignored the many countries, but these nations often remained outside the sects’ disputes, so it was as if they existed in a separate world.

As the Kingdom of Heavenly Thunder was in the western part of the continent, it wasn’t exactly strange that it had some contact with the Serene Cloud Sect, but even so, Qingyi couldn’t help but be surprised.
What would bring such a powerful sect to a place where even the most powerful experts barely stood a chance against their weakest core disciples?
Did they also have an interest in the lightning spirit? But why?
The thought took over Qingyi’s head, but he soon remembered a rumor he had heard in the Ascending Dragon Sect.
The current son of the Serene Cloud Sect had been born with a rare lightning constitution and spiritual root, and the sect was buying tons of resources related to cultivating lightning Qi.
’That complicates things...’ Qingyi frowned as the caravan finally arrived in front of the gates.
Dozens of guards at the peak of the Foundation Realm formed a barrier as the doors of the large, luxurious central carriage opened.
Out of it emerged a young man whose beauty was only slightly below that of Qingyi himself. His eyes were a deep blue and his black hair was elegantly tied up.
He looked just over twenty-two, but his Foundation Realm aura was profound, clearly just a single step away from reaching the Golden Core Realm.
His beautiful blue eyes swept the walls with dissatisfaction, focusing on a powerful-looking man equipped with imposing black plate armor.
This man shuddered under the young man’s gaze, his legs trembling as he leapt from the wall.
He landed heavily in front of the young man.
"Bao Heizi, Supreme Commander of the Royal Forces of the Heavenly Thunder Kingdom , greet young master Shen!" The man prostrated himself, but Young Master Shen only grunted in response.
"I remember that my father demanded a respectable welcoming ceremony."
"I beg your pardon, young master, you arrived earlier than-"
"No more excuses. Remove the commoners from the gates. I hope your king has prepared a proper banquet, at least."
Bao Heizi hesitated for a brief moment, but sensing the aura of the Iron Body Realm cultivator inside the carriage, he submitted.
"What are you waiting for? Make way for young master Shen!" Bao Heizi roared, and dozens of Foundation Realm auras fell on the line in front of the gate.
The animals became agitated and the merchants’ goods fell off their carts as they tried to get out as quickly as possible.
With everything cleared, the caravan from the Serene Cloud Sect finally entered the city and, after a few more minutes, the queue began to flow again.

"Ugh... those bastards from the main land have no respect for human life. Now that the secret realm is weakening, they want to take everything for themselves!" Xiaogou gritted his teeth, being silenced by Laosan’s stern gaze.
From Qingyi’s power and talent, Laosan was pretty sure that the young man was also from the main land, so what if he was offended?
Fortunately, Qingyi didn’t even seem to pay attention to those words, at least not beyond the last part.
"The secret realm is weakening? What do you mean?" Qingyi asked, curious.
Xiaogou was about to explain, but Laosan intervened. It was better not to let the brat say any more.
"They say that the secret realm is close to breaking.

The maximum entry level recently dropped from the Golden Core Realm to the Foundation Realm, and many young talents from the main land are coming here in search of trying to get as many benefits as possible from the breach."

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - Black Dragon Scales
paragraphs: With Laosan’s words, Qingyi finally understood why the Serene Cloud Sect was there.
Secret realms were naturally rare and lucrative.

A secret realm like the Tempest Secret Realm, which only allowed cultivators of the Golden Core Realm and below to enter, wouldn’t usually attract the attention of a powerful sect like the Serene Cloud, at least not in such a remote location.
Especially one with a death rate as high as this.
But a broken realm was different. All its resources were exposed and experts of any level could enter freely.

Although the Tempest Secret Realm was in decline, at its birth it allowed even Nascent Soul Realm cultivators to enter. Even for a powerful sect, the value of such a realm breaking down was inestimable.
If they found just a single artifact from a Nascent Soul Realm cultivator, it would be enough to raise their power by a long margin.
’The bastards probably want to take advantage of the weakening of the realm to get the Lightning Spirit...’ Qingyi gritted his teeth.
If all they wanted to do was simply take the resources from breaking the secret realm, someone like Young Master Shen wouldn’t be there.
They would probably get in his way, but in the end, Qingyi just shook his head.
With his current power, he didn’t fear anyone below the Golden Core Realm. Even if Young Master Shen had dozens of guards, Qingyi would finish them all off.
A subtle smile played on his lips. It had been a long time since he had humiliated an arrogant young master.
The queue went smoothly after young master Shen left.
After a quick check, they finally reached the wide central street of the city.
Qingyi’s eyes swept over the various establishments until they finally focused on a pavilion selling cultivation items on the horizon.
It was a large and luxurious building, even by Mainland standards.
"Where can I find you?" he asked, causing Laosan to turn his head.
"Well... we’ll be at the entrance to the secret realm early in the morning..." He stroked his thinning beard, his eyes widening as Qingyi jumped out of the carriage.
"I’ll meet you there!" Qingyi declared and soon his back disappeared over the horizon, leaving the group speechless.
Generally, their contractors would like to keep a close eye on them, especially to prevent them from running off with the money.
Qingyi didn’t think much of them, hurrying his steps towards the pavilion.
He still had a fortune in Lust points, and it was time to finally improve his lineage even further.
"Good morning, young master, what can I do for you?" An attendant greeted him respectfully.
"I need a cultivation room, the highest level you have."
Hearing those words, the attendant’s eyes lit up as she searched for something in a notebook in front of her desk.
That was one rich customer for sure!
"That’ll be 150 gold coins a night, young master, with a 70-times increase in Qi density and Foundation Realm training dummies!"

The 70-times increase in Qi density sounded very attractive, but the base Qi in the region was so scarce that Qingyi doubted whether it could even be half of what his private cultivation room in the sect offered.
He paid and was guided by the attendant to his cultivation room.
It was large, about a hundred square meters, surrounded by obsidian walls and illuminated by spirit crystals.
Qingyi stopped in the center of the room, feeling isolated from the outside world as the Qi density increased.
He breathed in deeply, feeling his cultivation move slightly.
Finally being away from the suffocation of such a low Qi density was truly liberating.
Focusing his mind, he opened his statuses.
[Name: Long Qingyi
Age: 18
Cultivation: Second stage of the foundation realm (700 lust points to upgrade)
Affinities: Lightning 60 - Sword: 60 - Charm: 1000 (can be upgraded in the lust store)
Spiritual roots: Seventh level lightning sword root (1000 lust points to upgrade, new roots can be bought in the lust store). )
Bloodline: Blood of the Corruption Dragon God (Rare grade, 10,000 lust points to upgrade.)
Constitution: Body of the primordial dragon (Rare grade, 10,000 lust points to upgrade.)
Lust points: 25637]
He was a little confused about what to do with so many Lust points.

He wasn’t ready to increase his cultivation yet, but one thing was certain: his bloodline and constitution were priorities, especially to fight with limited cultivation against a powerful enemy like the Lightning Spirit.
Preparing himself for the pain, he clicked on upgrade constitution first, trying to stay conscious while his body was gripped by a deep agony.
[Initiating constitution improvement...]
A muffled grunt escaped his lips as his muscles twitched, breaking down and being rebuilt in the next second.
His skin reddened before slowly becoming paler and smoother than before, his panting breaths gradually calming down.
[Constitution improved! Rare Grade -> Epic Grade]
Qingyi barely gave himself time to look at that notification, immediately clicking on improving the bloodline.
[Initiating bloodline improvement...]
His eyes felt like they were about to explode and his blood boiled. But not only that - this time, even his skin reacted, slowly breaking and bathing his clothes in blood.
It was painful, but the pain wasn’t the worst part, the agony was. When the pain finally stopped, his body was completely covered in blood.
[Bloodline improved! Rare Grade -> Epic Grade]
[You have unlocked a new lineage skill: Black Dragon Scales (lower)]
[A thread of draconic Qi awakens in your Dantian]

Noticing those notifications, Qingyi recovered from the shock of the pain immediately, spending a hundred Lust points on a pill to calm his mind before looking at his hand and focusing his draconic Qi on it.
His skin changed instantly, covering itself with black scales, glowing a faint purple under the light that illuminated the room.
His eyes glittered as he stood up, picking up his sword and swinging it with all his might towards his arm.
A metallic clang echoed as the sword bounced off his skin. Even using his lightning sword Qi, the effect was the same.
There was no improvement in his draconic eyes, but he didn’t care - that was even better than an improvement in his draconic eyes!

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - Tempest secret realm (01)
paragraphs: [Your cultivation has increased! Second stage of the foundation realm -> Third stage of the foundation realm, -700 lust points]
Qingyi stood up, feeling his body burn with power.
He hadn’t expected to advance to the third stage of the foundation realm in that cultivation session.

But when he stabilized his Qi with the increased density of the cultivation room, he immediately realized that the improvement of his spiritual roots had brought an even greater gain than he had expected.
Changing quickly, he opened his status screen.
[Name: Long Qingyi
Age: 18
Cultivation: Third stage of the foundation realm (800 lust points to upgrade)
Affinities: Lightning 60 - Sword: 60 - Charm: 1000 (can be upgraded in the lust store)
Spiritual roots: Seventh level lightning sword root (1000 lust points to upgrade, new roots can be bought in the lust store)
Bloodline: Blood of the Corruption Dragon God (Epic grade, 500,000 lust points to upgrade)
Constitution: Body of the primordial dragon (Epic grade, 500,000 lust points to upgrade)
Lust points: 1437]

After improving his constitution, he still had a little over five thousand lust points left, but he spent a considerable amount on cultivation pills and on advancing to the third stage of the foundation realm.
His base was still not very stable, but in the end, he could only sigh heavily.
It was enough.
His face was overcome with a pang of pain as he looked at the new price to increase his lineage and constitution.
He had expected a tenfold increase, but fifty? That was simply absurd.
Was the difference between Epic and Legendary really that tremendous?
With the income he had from his orgies with the lightning priestesses, he believed he should be able to achieve that amount in just a few months.
But that thought soon disappeared.
Every time he slept with a woman, the points he earned decreased more and more, and unless they had huge explosions in their cultivation levels, that would rarely change.
"It seems I won’t be able to improve my bloodline anytime soon..." Qingyi grunted as he picked up his sword and placed it on his waist.
Fortunately, these cultivation rooms were prepared for long sessions and had proper bathing facilities, so he didn’t have to worry about leaving covered in blood.
"Good morning, young master, did you have a pleasant cultivation session?"
When he came out, the attendant was already waiting for him with a bright smile, her face slightly flushed as she admired the young man’s handsome features.
"Yes," Qingyi replied briefly, giving the attendant a fat tip before stepping out onto the street.
His eyes rose to the sky, observing the height of the sun.
"I hope I’m not late..." he muttered as he quickened his pace toward the large black mountain on the horizon.
The clouds covering its peak were filled with even more violent thunder, crashing down on the mountain with deafening booms.
It didn’t take him long to leave the northern gates of the city, walking down a wide street that led to the mountain.

His steps stopped immediately when he saw a large black steel gate, rising almost ten meters high and encrusted with gold threads in thunderous patterns, similar to those that decorated the throne room of the Temple of the Lightning Spirit.
There were thousands of people waiting anxiously in front of the gates.

Most were in the Qi Refinement realm, but there were still at least a few hundred in the Foundation Realm, with a powerful Iron Body Realm cultivator sitting comfortably on a flying sword, his aura covering the entire region.
He was a middle-aged man in elegant blue robes with deep, wise eyes that studied everyone there as if they were slightly interesting insects.
Qingyi took only a brief glance at him before beginning to search for the Blue Wing mercenary group.
"Oh... young master Qingyi!" A mature female voice called out to him.
Turning around, he saw Mei waving alongside Xiaoguo, while the other three members of the group were seated around a map on the floor.
"Greetings, young master Qingyi!" Laosan stood up immediately upon noticing his presence, while Qingyi’s eyes focused on the map.
"What is this?" The handsome young man asked, approaching the group.
It appeared to be a map of some kind of tower divided into five floors, but only three were mapped out to a certain extent.
The first showed a dense forest, the second appeared to be some kind of cave network, while the third was a large palace.
There were markings all over these floors: spirit beast heads, crystals, and other points of interest.
"Ah... it’s nothing, we were just planning how to proceed in case... well..." Laosan looked away nervously.
They thought Qingyi would arrive much earlier, and well... what else could they do if their contractor didn’t arrive before the opening?
Qingyi didn’t care about that disrespect, studying the map with interest until he noticed something strange on the first floor.

Both the second and third floors were barely twenty percent mapped, but the first, on the other hand, was completely detailed, with the exception of a single black dot, right in the center of the forest.
Noticing Qingyi’s curious gaze, Laosan immediately explained:
"That’s a forbidden zone. We’ve never gone near it, but those who have been there say it’s just a bottomless pit surrounded by frightening auras."
"I see..." Qingyi scratched his chin, but didn’t have much time to study the map.
A grunt echoed as the door of a luxurious carriage opened, revealing the young master Shen of the Serene Cloud Sect.
The handsome and arrogant young man strode out with a confident smile.
Stopping in front of the carriage, he turned around, facing a figure that appeared right behind him.
It was difficult to discern whether that silhouette was male or female, completely covered by veils as white and pure as snow.
But from the light and delicate footsteps and the foolish smile that young master Shen wore on his face, Qingyi deduced that it would be a woman.
Young Master Shen raised his hand to help her down from the carriage, but she ignored it, walking right past him.
His face twisted for a brief moment, but he restrained himself, following the mysterious figure with hurried steps.

sentences.text: [Your cultivation has increased!
Second stage of the foundation realm -> Third stage of the foundation realm, -700 lust points]
Qingyi stood up, feeling his body burn with power.
He hadn’t expected to advance to the third stage of the foundation realm in that cultivation session.

But when he stabilized his Qi with the increased density of the cultivation room, he immediately realized that the improvement of his spiritual roots had brought an even greater gain than he had expected.
Changing quickly, he opened his status screen.
[Name: Long Qingyi
Age: 18
Cultivation: Third stage of the foundation realm (800 lust points to upgrade)
Affinities: Lightning 60 - Sword: 60 - Charm: 1000 (can be upgraded in the lust store)
Spiritual roots: Seventh level lightning sword root (1000 lust points to upgrade, new roots can be bought in the lust store)
Bloodline: Blood of the Corruption Dragon God (Epic grade, 500,000 lust points to upgrade)
Constitution: Body of the primordial dragon (Epic grade, 500,000 lust points to upgrade)
Lust points: 1437]

After improving his constitution, he still had a little over five thousand lust points left, but he spent a considerable amount on cultivation pills and on advancing to the third stage of the foundation realm.
His base was still not very stable, but in the end, he could only sigh heavily.
It was enough.
His face was overcome with a pang of pain as he looked at the new price to increase his lineage and constitution.
He had expected a tenfold increase, but fifty?
That was simply absurd.
Was the difference between Epic and Legendary really that tremendous?
With the income he had from his orgies with the lightning priestesses, he believed he should be able to achieve that amount in just a few months.
But that thought soon disappeared.
Every time he slept with a woman, the points he earned decreased more and more, and unless they had huge explosions in their cultivation levels, that would rarely change.
"It seems I won’t be able to improve my bloodline anytime soon..." Qingyi grunted as he picked up his sword and placed it on his waist.
Fortunately, these cultivation rooms were prepared for long sessions and had proper bathing facilities, so he didn’t have to worry about leaving covered in blood.
"Good morning, young master, did you have a pleasant cultivation session?"
When he came out, the attendant was already waiting for him with a bright smile, her face slightly flushed as she admired the young man’s handsome features.
"Yes," Qingyi replied briefly, giving the attendant a fat tip before stepping out onto the street.
His eyes rose to the sky, observing the height of the sun.
"I hope I’m not late..." he muttered as he quickened his pace toward the large black mountain on the horizon.
The clouds covering its peak were filled with even more violent thunder, crashing down on the mountain with deafening booms.
It didn’t take him long to leave the northern gates of the city, walking down a wide street that led to the mountain.

His steps stopped immediately when he saw a large black steel gate, rising almost ten meters high and encrusted with gold threads in thunderous patterns, similar to those that decorated the throne room of the Temple of the Lightning Spirit.
There were thousands of people waiting anxiously in front of the gates.

Most were in the Qi Refinement realm, but there were still at least a few hundred in the Foundation Realm, with a powerful Iron Body Realm cultivator sitting comfortably on a flying sword, his aura covering the entire region.
He was a middle-aged man in elegant blue robes with deep, wise eyes that studied everyone there as if they were slightly interesting insects.
Qingyi took only a brief glance at him before beginning to search for the Blue Wing mercenary group.
"Oh... young master Qingyi!" A mature female voice called out to him.
Turning around, he saw Mei waving alongside Xiaoguo, while the other three members of the group were seated around a map on the floor.
"Greetings, young master Qingyi!" Laosan stood up immediately upon noticing his presence, while Qingyi’s eyes focused on the map.
"What is this?" The handsome young man asked, approaching the group.
It appeared to be a map of some kind of tower divided into five floors, but only three were mapped out to a certain extent.
The first showed a dense forest, the second appeared to be some kind of cave network, while the third was a large palace.
There were markings all over these floors: spirit beast heads, crystals, and other points of interest.
"Ah... it’s nothing, we were just planning how to proceed in case... well..." Laosan looked away nervously.
They thought Qingyi would arrive much earlier, and well... what else could they do if their contractor didn’t arrive before the opening?
Qingyi didn’t care about that disrespect, studying the map with interest until he noticed something strange on the first floor.

Both the second and third floors were barely twenty percent mapped, but the first, on the other hand, was completely detailed, with the exception of a single black dot, right in the center of the forest.

"That’s a forbidden zone.
We’ve never gone near it, but those who have been there say it’s just a bottomless pit surrounded by frightening auras."

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - Tempest secret realm (02)
paragraphs: [Name: Qing Ruyan
Age: 22
Corruption: 0/100
Chastity: Intact
Lust: 0%
Talent: Genius
Reward: Extremely high.
Cultivation: Ninth stage of the golden core realm (suppressed to the ninth stage of the foundation realm)
Spiritual Roots: Low-level wind root.
Bloodline: None
Constitution: None
Traits: Faithful, Reserved, Graceful, Curious.]
Qingyi’s eyes lit up when he saw that woman’s stats, especially her low-level wind spiritual roots.
On the Blue Moon Continent, the standard for spiritual roots generally ranged from level 1 to level 9, defining trash and absolute geniuses.
But there was an additional classification after the 9th level spiritual roots, which were the low, medium, and high level spiritual roots, extremely rare even in the Nine Peaks Basin.
This woman’s spiritual root was only slightly below that of Tang Biyue, and even without a bloodline like the poisonous beauty, she would still be a great talent in the Nine Peaks Basin.
Qingyi shifted his gaze from her information to her figure, wondering what was hidden beneath those robes.
Unfortunately, he soon had to push that thought out of his mind.
A long, grave noise echoed and the black gates shook, their thunderous patterns glowing in a deep purple.
Everyone took a step back as a powerful lightning Qi spread across the corners of the gate, some weaker cultivators even suffering injuries as they tried to resist that Qi.
With a crash, the gates slowly opened, revealing a long layer of thunderous clouds.
Young Master Shen, the covered figure, and his dozens of guards were the first to enter, followed by the Foundation Realm cultivators.
"Let’s go." Qingyi quickened his pace, following the Foundation Realm cultivators.
"Y-young master Qingyi... isn’t this-" Laosan’s voice was interrupted by the powerful auras of the foundation realm experts, trying to ensure that no one passed them.
He felt his lungs grow heavy as his entire group struggled to breathe, but soon Qingyi spread his own aura, unrestrained, completely erasing the aura of everyone else.
Many impressed sighs echoed among the thousands of cultivators, and even the iron body realm expert’s gaze briefly fell on Qingyi.
Such a powerful aura in someone so young was a rare sight.
Qingyi ignored all these gazes, passing to the front of the line, and after a moment of hesitation, took a step into the layer of thunderous clouds.
The space around him seemed to distort for a brief moment, and when he realized it, he was on a large floating platform.
In front of him was a strange forest, its trunks were a deep purple and its leaves were blue, even the ground was unusual, covered with mushrooms that glowed faintly.
"Such rich lightning Qi..." Qingyi took a deep breath. There was almost no pure Qi in the entire region, only lightning Qi.
This place was truly a paradise for lightning cultivators.
The group of blue-winged mercenaries appeared right behind him, feeling a little strange that they were able to pass the experts in the foundation realm.

They were usually the last to enter, their eyes trembling as the many foundation realm cultivators passed them by, their footsteps soon turning into a run, those with movement techniques taking the lead.
"Why are they in such a hurry?" Qingyi asked.

"They are heading for the gates that lead to the second floor. Each gate opens once every 24 hours and allows twenty people to enter at a time. High-level cultivators can’t get much useful stuff on the first floor, so they try to get upstairs as quickly as possible." Laosan scratched the back of his neck as he looked around the platform.

"But we don’t need to worry too much about that. The first gate openings have a guardian powerful enough that it takes dozens of Foundation Realm cultivators to kill it, and even after killing it, it’s still necessary to hold the gate for an hour until it opens completely.
We just need to wait for three days and the path will be practically clear for us to ascend. In the meantime, we can—
"The marks on that map were the locations of the gates, right?" Qingyi interrupted Laosan, who paused for a brief moment before nodding.
"Great, meet me at the fourth gate." Qingyi announced as he activated his lightning steps.
"Wait!" Laosan tried to stop him, but it didn’t take long for Qingyi’s back to disappear completely on the horizon.
Was Qingyi really crazy enough to face the guardian alone?
Laosan was already on the verge of a headache, but soon sighed heavily.
Well, if Qingyi died, it would probably be for the best, since they had already been paid.
"Should we follow him?" Mei asked worriedly, looking at her other companions, she saw the exact same look.
No one there wanted to die by getting caught in a crossfire between the foundation realm experts.
Still, Laosan nodded: "Yes, but let’s just watch from afar."
He was almost certain that Qingyi would die, but what if he didn’t? He didn’t have the courage to offend a foundation realm cultivator like that.
Unaware of his guides’ thoughts, Qingyi quickly passed by all the other foundation realm experts. On the horizon, he immediately saw a black platform, and in its center was a single powerful beast.
"Giant lightning fox..." Qingyi muttered, observing the dark blue fur and pair of horns on top of the creature’s head, which was over three meters tall.

Being in the eighth stage of the foundation realm, it was a powerful beast, powerful enough that even several cultivators in the ninth stage of the foundation realm would have trouble dealing with it.
But Qingyi didn’t even think about that. The creature’s eyes suddenly opened, a beastly roar escaping from its mouth as it stood up, staring at Qingyi.
"Ready to die?" Qingyi smiled as he jumped as high as he could, his sword glowing with lightning sword Qi as he used the first form of the storm monarch’s sword art.
The beast immediately sensed the danger of that attack, covering its body with defensive Qi, but it wasn’t enough, holding Qingyi’s sword for a brief moment before finally giving way.
Blood splattered on Qingyi’s face as his blade sank into one of the Giant fox’s shoulders, causing a painful roar.

chapters.title: Chapter 89 - Tempest secret realm (03)
paragraphs: "Ugh..." Qingyi grunted as the beast unleashed all its Qi, its dark fur bristling and turning a deep blue as it backed away.
Qingyi took two steps back, his sword trembling in his hand as he watched the giant lightning fox.
Despite all the improvement of his bloodline placing him far above most ninth stage foundation realm cultivators, the difference between spirit beasts and humans was still too great.
Unfortunately for the beast, Qingyi was also far superior to any ordinary human cultivator.
His eyes flashed as he activated his draconic eyes, his body being covered by a thunderous cloak as he advanced, the steel platform shaking with every step he took.
The fox did not stand still either. With a leap, it rose dozens of meters, hovering above Qingyi for a single moment before curling its legs and beginning to spin.
Its body seemed to transform into a spear covered in thunder as it fell toward Qingyi, its jaws opening to reveal large, sharp teeth.
Qingyi did not move or defend himself, and the creature’s eyes flashed as it finally reached him.
It would enjoy that meal that he so humbly allowed himself to be devoured.
Its colossal jaws closed around Qingyi’s torso, the platform sinking under the weight of its fall and a burst of dust spreading through the air.
The spirit beast was waiting for the metallic, salty taste of human blood, which it hadn’t tasted in a long time. But that wasn’t what it tasted.
A sharp pain shot through its jaw, and it felt its teeth shatter.
The giant lightning fox roared in pain, its claws tearing at the ground as it tried to retreat, but Qingyi didn’t let it.
His body was covered in black scales, only a slight scratch marking the spot where the fox had bitten.
"You’re not going anywhere!" He growled as he grabbed its snout and thrust his sword into its neck.
He showed no mercy, his sword Qi cutting through as his lightning Qi destroyed everything inside it.
A gush of blood spurted from the beast’s half-open mouth as Qingyi’s sword finally reached its windpipe, bathing hin in crimson liquid rich in spiritual energy.
After long moments of struggle, the beast finally succumbed to its injuries, its eyes becoming dull and its limbs limp.
"Ah..." Qingyi sighed as he let the beast fall to the ground, looking at his clothes, now red with its blood.
"Will I never come out of a battle clean?" He muttered, but soon shook his head.
It was his fault and his fighting style. He could have come out of that battle much cleaner if he had simply fought in a more reserved manner.
But well... what would be the fun in that?
His eyes soon shifted from his clothes to his skin, still covered in dragon scales.
The resistance was much greater than any armor he could buy in the system.

He still didn’t have the arrogance to claim that he could withstand a blow from a golden core realm cultivator—the difference between the golden core and the foundation realm was too great—but he was very close to it.
The idea of crossing an entire cultivation realm made his blood boil.
If he reached that level, probably only the geniuses of the Nine Peaks Basin would be able to stand up to him.
A slight creak snapped him out of his thoughts as the platform vibrated gently.
At its center, he saw the ground opening up and a large gate slowly rising, still closed, small lines forming around it and flowing toward the center.
’This must be the waiting time Laosan spoke of...’ Qingyi scratched his chin. He was about to walk toward the gate when he remembered something.
His eyes focused on the beast’s corpse, and he felt the Qi-rich blood burning on his skin, no longer protected by the black dragon’s scales.
Now that he had a spatial ring, he no longer needed to leave these good things behind.
The giant lightning fox was a high-quality beast, far superior to the giant horned wolf he had killed for Lord Zhang.
They were so rare and hunted that even one in the foundation realm like this could be worth a fortune.
Of course, it didn’t have much use for Qingyi himself, but for an alchemist like Hua Feiyan, a body like that fox’s would be a gift from the heavens.
Qingyi raised his index finger, the space ring sucking the corpse inside. Time did not pass in his inner space, so he did not need to worry about anything spoiling.
’I wonder if this will be enough as an apology gift for her...’ Qingyi thought. ’No, it’s not even close...’ He concluded.
Knowing her well, he knew that she would probably use that corpse to make pills for him, not for herself.
How could something like that be a worthy payment?
His thoughts were soon diverted from the tanned beauty as he sensed dozens of auras approaching on the horizon.
He walked calmly and sat above the gate.
A few moments later, a crowd of foundation realm cultivators appeared, divided into three distinct groups.
Luckily, Young Master Shen was not among them. Qingyi did not want to deal with the arrogant young master, at least not yet.
The watchful eyes of the foundation realm cultivators scanned the black steel platform, searching for the spirit beast.
But they found nothing but pools of blood and a handsome young man sitting casually on the gate, bathed in crimson liquid.
Their faces were filled with confusion as the more powerful ones sensed Qingyi’s cultivation.
Third stage of the foundation realm...
That fox should be at least in the eighth stage of the foundation realm. How could she be defeated by someone like this?
’Six in the ninth stage of the foundation realm, fifteen in the eighth stage... the rest are trash.’ Qingyi thought as he studied them.
A cold smile took over his face as he questioned them, "Are you all going to come at once? Or would you rather line up to die?"

chapters.title: Chapter 90 - Tempest secret realm (04)
paragraphs: The experts of the foundation realm were overcome with a myriad of emotions upon hearing Qingyi’s words.
Did that young man want to challenge all of them alone?

Of course, the feat of killing that beast was absurd to their minds, but still, so many Foundation Realm cultivators had enough power to take down even Golden Core Realm experts, let alone a brat in the third stage of the Foundation Realm.
"Make way, kid, and I promise to crush your head before tearing off your legs!"
A tall, fat cultivator stepped forward, his face covered with a sadistic smile as he released his peak Foundation Realm aura.
"It’ll be slightly less painful, hahahaha!" He laughed, but soon noticed Qingyi shuddering under his Qi, the handsome young man’s cold smile completely fading.
That surprised him.
He wasn’t really willing to fight Qingyi, he just wanted to bluff to see if he would show any weakness.
But now, seeing Qingyi’s reaction, he immediately realized: the young man was bluffing too!
"That brat must have used some artifact on the giant lightning fox!" exclaimed another of the peak foundation realm cultivators, and soon all eyes on Qingyi changed.
An artifact capable of allowing a third stage foundation realm cultivator to defeat an eighth stage beast of the same realm...
How expensive must such an item be?
The fat man’s eyes immediately focused on Qingyi’s space ring. It was all there—the beast’s corpse and also the artifact used to kill it.
His cruel smile turned into greed as he activated his movement technique.
He was an earth cultivator, not a lightning cultivator, but he couldn’t ignore the treasures of that place.
His huge body shot forward on a board of earth, his fists already prepared to crush Qingyi.
"Bastards," he growled, noticing the presence of two other peak foundation realm cultivators following him, their faces carrying as much greed as his.
"He’s going to be mine!" he roared, finally reaching the platform and lunging toward Qingyi.
But at the last moment, his eyes met the young man’s.
Was he... smiling?
Qingyi stood up, his eyes glowing purple as he used the second form of the stormy monarch’s sword art, aiming at the throats of the three.
The fat man managed to dodge, Qingyi’s slash only grazing him and tearing out a strand of his red hair.
But the other two were unable to react in time, their bodies thrown by inertia, bouncing on the ground as they choked on their own blood.
Not even cultivators of the foundation realm were immune to having their throats slit.
The fat man stopped a few feet away from Qingyi and tried to defend himself, but it was already too late.
The handsome young man’s sword was already aimed at his chest as he used the first form of the stormy monarch’s sword art.
"I’m sorry..." Qingyi laughed mockingly as his sword sank into the fat man’s chest, piercing his heart. "But you guessed wrong."
The man’s eyes were wide as blood rose to his throat, his Dantian ceasing to respond as his consciousness faded.
Qingyi let his body fall heavily to the ground as he stood up, his eyes scanning the crowd of Foundation Realm cultivators.
There should be at least seventy of them.
The greed of those three had really made things easier for him, reducing the number of peak foundation realm cultivators by half.
But he still didn’t allow himself to relax or be blinded by arrogance. This was still a dangerous fight.
All the other Foundation Realm experts were paralyzed, their gazes fixed on the fallen bodies.
They were divided into three different groups, each led by two peak Foundation Realm experts.
By killing those three, Qingyi had eliminated one of the leaders of each group, and obviously, no one was happy about that.
"You son of a bitch!" One of the ninth stage foundation cultivators roared.
The fat man was his brother, and his eyes were close to tearing up as he stared at the corpse.
But he didn’t allow himself to cry. His heart overflowed with hatred as he advanced, his sword tearing through the air.
Qingyi used the first form of the tempest monarch’s sword art.
His qi molded itself into the shape of a sword tip before exploding toward the fat man’s brother.
Unfortunately, the man was already expecting this, easily dodging the attack before his body disappeared in a blur.
"Die, bastard!" He roared, swinging his sword toward Qingyi’s neck, who immediately activated the black dragon scales.
A metallic clang echoed, and the eyes of the peak foundation realm expert widened as his blade ricocheted off Qingyi’s skin.
He tried to recover, but Qingyi didn’t give him time.
His sword tore through the fat man’s brother’s belly, who screamed in pain before Qingyi slashed towards his throat, sending his head flying into the air.
"Shit!" Qingyi barely had time to recover his posture, sensing two powerful presences emerging behind him as the other two peak foundation realm cultivators appeared behind him.
He managed to cover his back in time to stop the first sword, but not the second, which sliced through his lower back, drawing a grunt of pain from his mouth.
He gritted his teeth as he turned around.
"Playing with death!" he roared as he finally released his lightning sword Qi at full power. A bluish aura covered in silver threads enveloped everything within two meters.
"How does this son of a bitch still have so much Qi?" the first expert asked, but Qingyi didn’t give him time to answer.
His body exploded in speed as he activated the first form of the tempest monarch’s sword art, aiming towards the second expert of the foundation realm.
"Damn it!" The man immediately realized that there was no time to dodge, raising his sword desperately as he forced all his Qi into defense.
He felt his muscles tear and his bones shake, the blade of his sword withstanding Qingyi’s attack for a brief moment before it began to melt.
His eyes were filled with terror as Qingyi’s sword sank into his chest, his painful screams quickly silenced.
The other cultivator at the peak of the Foundation Realm tried to flee, but in the end, he met the same fate.
Standing over the six bloody corpses, Qingyi raised his eyes to the rest of the Foundation Realm experts.
"I’m waiting... bring me your necks so I can free them from the weight of your heads!"

"Make way, kid, and I promise to crush your head before tearing off your legs!"
A tall, fat cultivator stepped forward, his face covered with a sadistic smile as he released his peak Foundation Realm aura.
"It’ll be slightly less painful, hahahaha!" He laughed, but soon noticed Qingyi shuddering under his Qi, the handsome young man’s cold smile completely fading.

He wasn’t really willing to fight Qingyi, he just wanted to bluff to see if he would show any weakness.
