chapters.title: Chapter 91 - Tempest secret realm (05)
paragraphs: Despite Qingyi’s threats, none of the foundation realm cultivators dared to move.
Their eyes shifted between the beautiful, bloodied figure and the corpses scattered across the ground.
Even though they had witnessed everything with their own eyes, it was still hard to believe.
It only took one of them to take a step back for the rest to begin retreating.
That young man was clearly an incomparable genius. It was not worth continuing that fight.
Even if he was injured and they had a high chance of victory, how many would still die to gain just a few more hours on the upper floors?
"Ah..." Qingyi exhaled as he sat cross-legged, circulating his Qi.
Despite the sharp pain, it was not a deep wound.
"Oh... young master Qingyi is amazing!" He heard a cheerful and excited voice. Opening his eyes, he saw Xiaoguo, Laosan, and the rest of his group.
The young man had a bright look toward Qingyi as he looked at the corpses.
The carnage didn’t shock him—that was how this world worked. He had always known that, from the moment he decided to become a cultivator.
Laosan, on the other hand, was a little agitated and even regretful.
The money was good, of course, but did they really have to get involved with someone so scary?
Qingyi ignored them, continuing to focus on his wound.
It didn’t take long to heal it completely, the Qi flowing through his torn flesh, restoring it without leaving a single scar on his pale skin.
Opening his eyes, he stood up and looked at the gate. It wouldn’t be long before it opened.
"What are the next two floors like?" Qingyi asked, looking at the horizon.
A loud bang echoed, followed by a blinding light that cut through the sky like a silver blade.
It probably came from one of the gates, whose guardian had been defeated even before Qingyi’s.
There was only one person among all the foundation cultivators who would have the power to do that: Young Master Shen.
This obviously worried him.
He was almost certain that the Serene Cloud Sect was there for the lightning spirit.
He needed to get to the fifth floor as quickly as possible.
Laosan hesitated for a brief moment, his eyes also focused on the light on the horizon.
"The second floor is basically a maze. I don’t know much about how it works.
We only got through it by luck, wandering aimlessly while mining Qi crystals and eventually finding a door that led to the third floor."
Qingyi nodded silently before asking, "And the third?"
He hated things that depended on luck, but with his draconic eyes, he doubted very much that he wouldn’t be able to find some pattern that would lead to the door.
"Well... Actually... we only stayed there for an hour.
It’s like a forest, in the center of it all, there’s a gold mansion, but we just looked at it from afar before turning back. The whole place was full of spirit beasts from the foundation realm."
Hearing those words, Qingyi sighed before shaking her head. That information wasn’t very useful.
"But we know what the challenge to climb to the fourth floor is like!" Laosan hurriedly said, regaining Qingyi’s interest.
"It’s a test of technique. There are two gates, and to open them, you have to cut the gates in half! Whoever opens them can allow up to four other people to enter."
"So simple?" The handsome young man raised his eyebrows, but soon shook his head. Obviously, it wasn’t that simple; there must be something else.
’The first was a test of power, the second seems to be some kind of perception test, while the third is a test of technique...’
"And the fourth floor?"
"It’s a room." This time, it was Chen Tiezhu who answered. He was a rough-looking man of few words.
Seeming to think about something for a brief moment, he continued, "It’s just a dimly lit room with a final gate leading to the fifth floor.

Ten people can enter that gate, but no one has ever come back. That’s why they say that the fifth floor is the last one, where the master of the secret realm lives, killing everyone who dares to enter.
"I see..." Qingyi scratched his chin as he pondered those last words, but he didn’t have much time to delve deeper into his thoughts.
A loud crack echoed and the density of Qi around him briefly exploded, vibrating against his skin as the door opened with a burst of light.
Its interior revealed the same layer of black clouds as the entrance to the secret realm.
"If you want to follow me, you can, but I won’t wait for anyone," Qingyi declared as he took a step toward the gate.
The information he had obtained from them had not been much better than what he could probably get by buying a drink for some local drunk in a bar, but he did not waste time thinking about it.
He hoped to be able to explore the place more calmly and also make some gains from the countless opportunities that this place held, and in that case, they would have been very useful.
Unfortunately, that was not the case.
He had to hurry and reach the lightning spirit before it was too late.
If the rumors about young master Shen’s talent were true, he really had a real chance of being accepted by the lightning spirit.
The texts in the lightning spirit temple clearly stated that the spirit would only accept one of its priestesses, but Qingyi obviously would not be convinced by that.
The texts did not mention anything about any secret realm, nor about the challenges to reach the highest levels; their reliability was not very high.
Soon after Qingyi’s back disappeared through the door, the group exchanged glances.
"Should we follow him?" Li Gouzi asked, but the looks on everyone’s faces made it very obvious.
No fucking way! That handsome young master was clearly a magnet for trouble!
"How about we call it a day and go for a drink?" Xiaoguo proposed, eliciting smiles from the whole group.
"That’s the best idea you’ve had since you joined the group, brat," Laosan ruffled Xiaoguo’s hair before turning toward the horizon.
"I’ll drink anything, as long as it’s on you!" Mei smiled as she hugged Xiaoguo from behind, drawing an embarrassed cry from him.
Soon, the first floor of the secret realm was filled with laughter as the group withdrew.

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - Tempest secret realm (06)
paragraphs: The moment he passed through the gate, Qingyi immediately felt the air around him change.
The air on the second floor was pure and light, each breath filling his lungs with vitality, just like in the lightning spirit temple.
But now it was different, heavy, with his senses immediately being repressed to a fraction of what they were before.
The density of Qi became so low that he felt as if he were back on earth.
"This is going to be problematic..." he muttered as the gate at his back closed, its light no longer illuminating the place.
Within seconds, Qingyi found himself in complete darkness.
He drew his sword and covered it with his lightning sword Qi, managing to illuminate no more than five meters around him.
He looked at the walls, made of a rustic brown stone.
Despite the wooden pillars supporting it, there were no pickaxe marks or any indication that it had been dug by human hands.
Closing his eyes, he placed his hand on the rough surface, feeling the Qi pass through it.
It was faint, almost non-existent, but when he activated his draconic eyes, he could see the lines of Qi easily.
He seemed to be in some kind of tunnel.
To his left, the lines descended before splitting into four distinct paths, slowly losing strength.
To the right, they continued in a straight path before gradually rising, their intensity becoming greater and greater.
After thinking for a moment, Qingyi took the right. Every few seconds, he scanned his surroundings, but couldn’t feel anything.
It was only after almost ten minutes of walking that his steps suddenly stopped. He crouched down, his eyes catching a small glow beneath his feet.
"Inferior Qi crystal," he muttered as he picked up a small translucent crystal, not much bigger than a fingernail.
This type of crystal was not very uncommon in the outer region of the Blue Moon Continent, being used by wealthy cultivators for illumination and to slightly increase the density of Qi in an area.
But the places where these crystals were found were still very rare and, generally, where there were inferior crystals, there were superior ones.
These were much rarer and were in fact the standard currency used in the Nine Peaks Basin.
Even the Ascending Dragon Sect shouldn’t have much more than a few dozen or hundred of these precious crystals.
After observing the crystal for a few more moments, Qingyi put it away and continued to follow the tunnel.
After more than thirty minutes, his steps stopped again.
The intensity of the Qi lines had stopped increasing, all converging on a single point on the wall.
He covered his hand with lightning Qi before punching, a bang echoing and the tunnel shaking, but it still didn’t budge.
Closing his eyes, he calmed his mind and again gathered the Qi in his hand, this time using both sword and lightning Qi.
When his eyes opened, he attacked again.
His attack had a fraction of the power of the previous one, but even so, the wall in front of him immediately crumbled, revealing a black steel door.
Without hesitation, Qingyi opened the door and stepped inside, feeling the space around him distort.
When he realized it, he felt the air become pure again and the density of Qi explode.
It seemed as if he had returned to the second floor, surrounded by a strange but beautiful forest.
With a slight impulse, he jumped above the trees and observed the scenery around him. The place seemed to be around two hundred square kilometers.
On the horizon, he could see large black walls rising up and closing in at the top, where a single thunderous crystal illuminated everything with a bluish light.
Exactly in the center of the third floor was a mansion, large and luxurious, its central courtyard hidden by golden gates.
Qingyi prepared to set off in that direction, but he soon sensed dozens of Foundation Realm auras.
Most of them were spirit beasts, but he could feel some auras from cultivators too, all at the peak of the Foundation Realm.
"Are these Young Master Shen’s guards?" he wondered.
It made sense that the guards were holding back the beasts while Young Master Shen tried to ascend to the fourth floor as quickly as possible.
"Why are those bastards so fast?" he gritted his teeth before activating his lightning steps, leaping over the treetops.

"Shit, where did that bastard come from?" One of the guards fighting a powerful spirit beast exclaimed, his eyes focusing on Qingyi for a brief moment before he was forced to turn his attention to the beast in front of him.
This was a dangerous battle, he couldn’t afford to lose his focus for too long.
"Someone’s go after him! Young Master Shen will be furious if we let him through!" Another guard roared and soon, Qingyi felt two auras behind him.
But he didn’t even care much about these guards.
Forcing a little more Qi into his feet, he exploded into speed, leaving them behind.
It wasn’t long before he leapt over the mansion’s great wall, landing in a wide, luxurious courtyard.
The mansion seemed to be completely locked, surrounded by powerful spiritual harnesses, but Qingyi didn’t pay much attention to them.
His eyes soon focused on the two gates at the front of the mansion and the two figures standing next to one of these gates.
Young Master Shen was already panting, the gate in front of him marked by dozens of blade marks, but he still didn’t seem to be anywhere close to giving in.
Right next to him was the small, delicate figure of Qing Ruyan.

Her veil was slightly open, revealing the pale, jade-perfect skin of her thin, rounded chin and full, curved cherry lips, glistening faintly in the light of the large crystal as she sipped from a cup of tea.
That woman was a transcendental beauty, Qingyi was immediately sure of it.
She noticed Qingyi’s presence, curiously turning her face towards him.

Her veil was slightly open, revealing the pale, jade-perfect skin of her thin, rounded chin and full, curved cherry lips, glistening faintly in the light of the large crystal as she sipped from a cup of tea.
That woman was a transcendental beauty, Qingyi was immediately sure of it.
She noticed Qingyi’s presence, curiously turning her face towards him.

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - Tempest secret realm (07)
paragraphs: "What do you think you’re looking at, peasant?" Young Master Shen growled, taking Qingyi’s attention away from Qing Ruyan.
’Ah... should I finish off this bum now?" Qingyi asked himself, but when he looked at Qing Ruyan again, he decided that it wouldn’t be a good idea.
He had the confidence to deal with Young Master Shen, but if Qing Ruyan entered the fray, he would probably be defeated.
They weren’t like those mediocre experts he had faced on the second floor.
"I beg young master Shen’s pardon," Qingyi bowed his head as he clenched his fists respectfully.
"This is just a humble cultivator who ended up here by luck and doesn’t have the power to leave on his own."
"Humpf." Young Master Shen snorted at those words.
Noticing Qingyi’s cultivation, he focused his attention back on the gate in front of him.
"Wait in a corner and don’t get in the way. My guards will escort you back after we’ve finished."
Regardless of how bad his personality was, Young Master Shen was still an orthodox cultivator.
Since Qingyi seemed to know his place, he paid no further attention to him.
The covered beauty, on the other hand, didn’t seem to care much about the two of them, sipping her tea calmly as she watched Young Master Shen’s attempts.
Beneath the veil, Qingyi could see beautiful blue eyes twinkling slightly as she watched the gate.
Turning away, Qingyi also focused her vision on the gate, activating her draconic eyes.
It was... strange.
Everything in that world had Qi, some in high density, some in low, but nothing was truly without Qi.
That gate was no different, covered in an extremely dense and repressed Qi, without a single drop leaking from its interior.
But this Qi was peculiar.

Qi usually organized itself chaotically, flowing like waves on a sea, but in this gate, the Qi was different, made of thousands of perfectly aligned lines with spaces equivalent to the sharpness of a blade separating them.
He looked at young master Shen, attacking desperately, putting more and more force into his movements.
The ground cracked and the gate shook, but nothing happened, just more and more clumsy cuts piling up.
"Young master Shen..."
Qingyi heard a voice that immediately snapped him out of his stupor.
It was feminine, gentle and soft, like a refreshing, light breeze on a sunny day.
Turning his gaze, he saw Ruyan’s figure rise elegantly, the veil falling over the rest of her face, again completely concealing what little of her beauty was visible.
"May I?" She asked sweetly and, with a gentle gesture, her tea disappeared into its spatial ring.
"Oh... of course!" Young Master Shen paused for a moment before stepping back, his eyes shining as he watched Ruyan’s figure, as if trying to see through her veil.
It was a pity that her father had insisted that she cover herself completely before coming to this place.
Ruyan ignored that lookm she was used to it.
Her long, delicate fingers left the protection of her robes for a brief moment, grasping the handle of her sword.
It was clearly a spirit sword, and an expensive one at that.
A sharp hiss echoed as the steel slid out of the scabbard, revealing a bluish-silver single-edged blade, its handle covered in elegant jewels.
"Ah..." A sweet, long sigh escaped her lips as she readied her sword.
The next moment, she attacked.
Her blow had only a fraction of the power of Young Master Shen’s attacks, a slow, elegant swing, more suited to a dance than a real attack.
But the moment it found the gate, the blade sliced through it like butter.
A crash echoed as the two sides of the gate parted, revealing the passage covered in thunderclouds.
Without hesitation, she stepped forward, her body disappearing into the mist.
"Wait!" Young Master Shen ran right behind, but couldn’t help stopping at the last moment, casting a murderous glance in Qingyi’s direction.
"Don’t you dare follow us!" he growled before also entering the passageway.
Qingyi shook his head, walking towards the other gate.
He could simply follow the same path as young master Shen, but he also wanted to try out his theory.
He drew his sword and activated his draconic eyes, studying the lines for a brief moment before attacking, aiming for the space between them.
With his vision technique, it wasn’t too difficult.
To his surprise, he felt no resistance as his sword sank into the gate. It seemed like it was cutting through the air.
The gate opened, revealing a passage covered in thunderclouds.
Qingyi didn’t think long before entering the blanket of clouds, the space around him distorting before he finally appeared on the other side.
That was the fourth floor, the last one before he could finally meet the lightning spirit.
He was anxious, but he didn’t let it show, observing his surroundings.
To call that place a simple room was a huge understatement.
It was easily hundreds of meters, with a floor, walls and ceiling made of black, uneven stones.
"You bastard, I ordered you not to follow us!" Qingyi heard the roar of Young Master Shen, whose sword was already in his fists.
Qingyi had disobeyed his orders, the punishment for which was nothing but death.
"Die!" He attacked, his sword covered in a powerful lightning aura as it flowed towards Qingyi.
Qingyi barely paid attention to the attack, using the first form of the Tempest Monarch’s sword art.
"What?" Young Master Shen’s eyes filled with shock as his sword collided with Qingyi’s attack.
He had expected to be able to deal with it easily, but he felt his arms give way in the next moment, his feet being ripped from the ground as he was thrown to the opposite side.
His body hit the wall with a loud explosion, sinking into the stone.
"I’m sorry, but I have a great interest in this lightning spirit and I won’t share it. So I’ll ask you to leave," Qingyi didn’t hold back, revealing his full aura and murderous intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - Tempest secret realm (08)
paragraphs: Young Master Shen could hardly believe his own eyes as he was thrown into the air, but the pain of hitting the wall woke him up immediately, his sword slipping from his grasp.
"Blergh!" He vomited a gulp of blood as he fell to his knees.
He had his guard completely down and had barely used 30% of his power in that attack, but even so, he shouldn’t have been pushed back so humiliatingly by someone of such inferior cultivation.
Qingyi just watched him coldly, his eyes turning to Ruyan.
She seemed uninterested, sitting down on a large stone in the corner of the room.
She removed her teacup from the space ring and went back to drinking as if nothing had happened.
The handsome young man couldn’t help but feel relieved.
If he were to take them both on at once, he would be in trouble, but he was confident that he could defeat them one by one.
After thinking for a moment, he raised his vision, watching young master Shen.
"I’m in a hurry, let’s get this over with." He spoke, his words were arrogant, but his voice was cold and unconcerned.
"You..." Young Master Shen gritted his teeth, swallowing a healing pill.
As the son of the leader of one of the most powerful sects in the entire outer region of the Blue Moon Continent, he obviously only used pills of the highest quality.
He only needed a single moment to recover from all his injuries, the fatigue being swept from his body like dust in the wind.
"I’ll skin him alive!" He roared as he picked up his sword from the ground, also a spirit sword, its blade covered in thunderous patterns that shone brightly as he circulated his Qi through it.
"Try it!" Qingyi smiled, covering his blade with lightning sword Qi as he advanced.
Their swords met with a deafening clang, their lightning Qi tearing up the ground beneath their feet.
After a brief clash, they retreated, their swords meeting dozens of times in succession, each blow powerful enough to make the air tremble and the ground give way under the pressure.
"Die!" Young Master Shen roared as he pushed every drop of Qi into his sword, his hands trembling and his heart overflowing with hatred.
Just... how could that bastard be so strong?
He was the pride of the Serene Cloud Sect, his father always said he was the most talented of the younger generation.
How could he lose like that to an ant of the third stage of the Foundation Realm? He couldn’t accept that!
But still, nothing changed.
Qingyi once again used the first form of the Storm Monarch’s sword art, retracting his blade for a brief moment before thrusting.
Their swords met and Qingyi shuddered.
’Does this bastard really want to fight to the death?’ He frowned, his feet tearing up the ground as he was forced to retreat.
’No, he’s not giving it his all yet...’ Qingyi forced out his own Qi, his meridians burning as he pushed young master Shen back.
"If you really want to kill me, you’d better give it your all." Qingyi said.
"You want to see all my power?..." The young master gritted his teeth, clenching his jaw hard enough for his gums to bleed. "Good!"
The next moment, his body was surrounded by a thunderous aura, but this one was different.
Qingyi felt the heat from afar, his hair fluttering, a frightening Qi taking over everything around him.
This was a powerful technique, more powerful than anything he had ever faced before.
The aura around young master Shen continued to expand outwards from his body, stopping just short of ten meters.
The temperature around him was high enough to make the little water between those stones boil.
"I’ll kill you a thousand times!" Young Master Shen roared, advancing towards Qingyi, his body transformed into five distinct bolts of lightning that soon united into one.
Qingyi raised his sword, his eyes shining as he drew every last drop of Qi from his Dantian, his body surrounded by silver-blue lightning.
When their swords met, there was no clang, quite the contrary, the world seemed to fall into absolute silence.
Qingyi felt every muscle in his body screaming in agony, slowly tearing apart as he was pushed back.
He roared in pain, activating the first form of the Tempest Monarch Sword Art. His Qi reserves were rapidly depleting, but he didn’t care.
"Give in, you son of a bitch!!" Young Master Shen’s roar echoed, his eyes flashing as a metallic clang reached his ears and Qingyi’s sword shattered into sparkling fragments.
"Shit!" Qingyi barely had time to raise his arms, activating the black dragon scales and praying that they would withstand the impact.
"Fuck you!" Young Master Shen pushed, sending Qingyi flying.
The handsome young man’s body hit a wall, the stones cracking and a burst of dust rising in a thick cloud.
Young Master Shen gasped for a few moments, a triumphant smile spreading across his face.
Unfortunately, that triumphant smile didn’t last long. A sharp pain shot through his jaw as he was thrown to the ground with brutal force.
"What-?" He opened his mouth, but was quickly silenced again by Qingyi’s fist.
Without giving Young Master Shen time to recover, Qingyi continued punching, his fists covered in blood as he destroyed his opponent’s front teeth with relentless blows.
He raised his fist one last time, forcing the little Qi he had left in his body before letting it fall toward Young Master Shen’s face.
Unfortunately, he didn’t have time to touch him.
An explosion sent him flying backward, Young Master Shen’s spatial ring cracking and illuminating the entire room with an intense golden energy that momentarily blinded everyone.
"I will have my revenge!" he roared before his body disappeared.
"An emergency teleportation talisman?" Qingyi stood up, his face contorted in pain as he focused his gaze on Qing Ruyan.
She seemed slightly surprised, but not much more than that. She had already finished her cup of tea and, with a soft sigh, stood up elegantly.
"Do you wish to face me as well?" He asked, assuming a defensive stance and getting ready to take a sword from the system.

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - Tempest secret realm (09)
paragraphs: Qing Ruyan did not respond immediately to Qingyi, her eyes carefully filtering him.
The white veil was almost thin enough for him to see her face, and it still allowed him to see her eyes, which shone faintly.
"I heard about a big commotion in the ascending dragon sect a few months ago..." Her lips curved into a subtle smile as she lifted the veil.
Long black hair cascaded over her slender shoulders, framing a delicate and beautiful face with high cheekbones, full cherry lips, and a small, slightly upturned nose.
She was, indeed, a peerless beauty.

"An expert from the Nine Peaks Basin appeared because of an attack by the demonic cult, and when she left, she took a young man with her..." Ruyan took a step forward, and Qingyi stepped back, his eyes flickering slightly.
How did that woman know all that?
Noticing his reaction, a soft laugh escaped the young woman’s lips, her face turning slightly as she studied Qingyi’s features.
The fair, flawless skin of her cheeks turned slightly pink when she looked away, but she quickly recovered, assuming a serious expression.
"Don’t worry, I don’t care about the affairs of the Ascending Dragon Sect, I was just curious about what could lead such a powerful expert to take an interest in someone from this region."
Her eyes moved down from Qingyi’s face, focusing on his arms still covered in black scales, blood dripping from the small cut left by Young Master Shen’s attack.
"I am Qing Ruyan, a direct disciple of the Serene Cloud Sect."
Qingyi hesitated for a brief moment, but soon forced the fatigue out of his face, greeting her respectfully.
"This one is Long Qingyi, an external disciple of the Ascending Dragon Sect. How did senior discover my identity?"
"I was in the capital of the Golden Sun Kingdom until last month, and I met your woman there.
"Hua Feiyan?" Qingyi briefly lost control of his emotions, approaching Ruyan, his face inches from hers. "How is she? What was she doing there?"
"Well..." Ruyan blushed, her eyes avoiding Qingyi’s piercing gaze.
’He smells good... despite the sweat.’ Her gaze flowed to the opening in his robe, damaged by battle and revealing part of his powerful abdomen. ’Ugh... what are you thinking, Ruyan? Focus!’
"Ah... I’m sorry!" Qingyi sensed the sweet floral fragrance emanating from her body, realizing they were too close, he stepped back.
"I-it’s okay..."
There was an awkward silence between them before Ruyan finally regained her composure.

"We met at a ball at the royal palace. The crown prince is about to turn 100, and the royal family has summoned all the young alchemy talents in the kingdom to make the best breakthrough pill for the golden core realm. She will be participating in the competition that is supposed to take place in a few weeks."
"I see..." Qingyi lowered his head, deep in thought.
He had already heard rumors about the crown prince’s birthday and his talent while he was in the sect, one of the least talented of his generation.
It made sense that Feiyan, the greatest alchemy talent in the ascending dragon sect, would participate in this kind of competition.
"If I were you, I would run back to the realm of the blazing sun as fast as I could. We talked about a lot of things, especially about you, but we also talked about the royal family.
They seem to be very interested in marrying her to the crown prince."
"They are interested in WHAT?" Qingyi froze.
The moment those words entered his ears, he felt his blood boil.
They want to marry his Feiyan to some talentless old bag of bones? he gritted his teeth, but soon calmed down.
There was no chance the sect would agree to that. The royal family knew that well, it was probably the old man’s personal interest.
"Ah..." he sighed. He really just wanted to transcend and live a peaceful life, fucking his women and relaxing for the rest of eternity.
But the pigs always gathered at his feet, begging for the cold steel of his blade.
His eyes were filled with murderous intent and his fists clenched hard enough to tear his skin.
He closed his eyes, calming his heart before bowing to Ruyan.
"Thank you very much for the information, senior. If we don’t kill each other today, I promise to repay you a thousand times over."
"Hahaha, don’t worry." A soft, sincere laugh escaped from the beauty’s lips.

"Shen Yulan was the one who was interested in that lightning spirit. I only came with him because the sect leader basically forced me to accompany him. He is an unpleasant man and believes that something will develop between us if we travel toget-"
She covered her mouth, realizing she had spoken a little too much.
"I hope to see you again someday." Her words flowed throughout the fourth floor as she took a talisman from her space ring and tore it, her body disappearing in a column of light.
When he found himself alone again, Qingyi couldn’t help but exhale wearily and sit cross-legged, circulating his Qi and looking at the wound on his arms.
Young Master Shen’s attack had managed to break through his defenses and even cut through his black dragon scales.
It wasn’t a big cut, at least not compared to what would have happened if he hadn’t had that skill active, but still, it was a cut, and that worried him.
He was almost certain that his techniques were superior to those of any cultivator in the foundation realm, but seeing young master Shen’s technique, he immediately realized he was wrong.
The world was very large and full of hidden talents.
With a sigh, he continued to recover. The lightning spirit would probably make up for what was lacking in his techniques.
After many hours, he finally opened his eyes, feeling his body full of energy.
Fortunately, he had not suffered any internal injuries other than a few broken ribs and his dantian being emptied.
With the density of lightning Qi in this place, it was not difficult to recover from this with just a low-quality healing pill.
Qingyi stood up, his eyes focused on a single door at the end of the room. Buying a sword from the system store, he opened the door.

When she finally calmed down, still sniffling, Qingyi slowly lifted his torso, sat down and pulled her against him, hugging her tightly.
"I’m sorry, but they’re fine... the temple still exists and they’re still waiting for you, for the day when they can rise again."
"Did you take them as women too?" Ruxue asked, her voice still shaky, but calmer now.
"Yes." Qingyi nodded.
"Fucking womanizer!" She punched his chest one last time, but her fist didn’t have any force, just enough to make Qingyi’s skin tingle.
Seeing that sight, Qingyi couldn’t help but laugh, kissing her passionately.
When their lips parted, he forced a serious expression onto his face.
"You didn’t really kill any of the priestesses who came here after you?"
"No, I would never hurt them!"
"What about the floors below this one?
Why did you create them and make them so deadly?"
"What do you mean?" Ruxue turned her face away in confusion.
"I didn’t create any floors, nor any kind of challenge."
Those words made Qingyi shudder.
She hadn’t created any floors or any challenges, which meant that someone else had.
The fact that she had thrown the key that controlled her sealing place into an abyss made him even more certain.
Someone had found this key and modified this place, which was why this place was so strange as a secret realm.
"The control key gave the power to control what, exactly?" He asked, feeling his heart racing.
"Everything except this place..."
"Go back to the sword." Qingyi grabbed Ruxue’s hips as he stood up, putting her on her feet before picking up the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword and gripping it tightly.
"Why?" Ruxue asked, sensing Qingyi’s emotions.
"Just do it, now!" He put more force into his voice and without further question, Ruxue turned into a thunderous mist, flowing towards the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword.
Sighing for a moment, Qingyi opened his status screen and clicked to improve his cultivation.
A subtle pain followed by a gentle refreshment took over of his body as he walked towards the exit of that place.
[Your cultivation has increased!
Third stage of the foundation realm -> Fourth stage of the foundation realm, -800 lust points]
He had finally reached the fourth stage of the foundation realm, but he couldn’t feel even a little happy about it.
